name: patidar-samaj-site
description: Uttar Gujarat Kadva Patidar Samaj — community website, member workspace and admin panel (MERN)

scripts.install:all: npm run check:node && npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: npm run check:node && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run check:node && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.audit: npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev
